_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score is coiling in Hope with no momentum or F&G trigger to leave the band; base-rate and analyst both favor HOLD until a breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst explicit HOLD/Hope; narrative outflow story is cautionary but silent on phase/direction — no clean forward agreement
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear_greed holds 55-70, funding stays flat, BTC remains range-bound without thrust
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum and F&G both clear the analog gap (mid-70s / >72) or long-liquidation flush drives F&G under 50 with VIX factor rising
